candidates.label: A · Baseline
candidates.prompt: Extract the useful lead details as JSON.

candidates.label: B · Structured
candidates.prompt: Return only JSON matching the supplied lead-intake schema. Use null or unknown when the source does not support a value.

candidates.label: C · Repair
candidates.prompt: Return schema-valid lead-intake JSON. If a relative date lacks a timezone or reference date, repair it to null rather than inventing a date.
